items.prompt: The lights are on. She ___ be home.

items.prompt: That ___ be John — he's in Tokyo this week.

items.prompt: Rewrite with 'can't' to express impossibility: "It is impossible that he is at home now."
answers: He can't be at home now
He cannot be at home now

items.prompt: Find and correct the mistake: "He must to be at work by now."
answers: He must be at work by now
items.explanation: Modal verbs take the bare infinitive — no 'to'.
